title: 기술대학설립ㆍ운영규정시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.
Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (21) Omitted.
(22) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Technical Colleges shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1), Article 3, Article 4 (1), the former part of paragraph (2), Articles 5 and 6, Article 9 (1), and Article 12, "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Education."
(23) through (61) Omitted.
